thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @Alice N., @Brian SRE — elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts in hosted/us-west beginning ~1782345600. Error rate alarm fired (ERROR_RATE_P99). Please ACK.

Alice N.: ack. I'm on it. Looking at gateway and ratelimiter dashboards.

Brian SRE: ack — can join in ~10m unless you need immediate backup.

SRE-Lead: I'm awake. If this is quota-related, be prepared to revert the recent ratelimit change that rolled out ~1782342000.

Alice N.: preliminary: surge of 429s at the gateway correlating with a subsequent spike of 502/504 from backends. Gateway pod CPU + outbound RPS both spiked.

Alice N.: log sample:
```
[2026-03-13T18:19:57Z] gateway req=xyz1 client=cust-123 status=429 reason="quota_exceeded:global"
[2026-03-13T18:20:11Z] gateway req=xyz2 client=cust-456 status=429 reason="quota_exceeded:global"
[2026-03-13T18:20:45Z] backend req=xyz1 status=504 upstream_deadline_exceeded
```

Maria Support: multiple customers contacting support with SDK retries and intermittent failures. Marking Cust-123, Cust-456 as high-touch.

Jamie (Product): flagging customer comms. Keep me updated — we'll need a status note if this persists.

Alice N.: config inspection: ratelimit-config:v2 has `scope: cluster` and `global_quota: 1200/min`. intended was `scope: tenant` with per-tenant quotas. Change likely surfaced cluster-wide due to label mismatch in rollout.

SRE-Lead: proceed with emergency revert of ratelimit-config. Prioritize stability over graceful deployment.

Alice N.: executing:
```
kubectl apply -n infra -f ratelimit-config-v1.yaml
kubectl rollout restart deploy/gateway -n infra
``` 

ops-bot: restart initiated by Alice N. job_id=do-1782345701. Watching pod readiness.

Brian SRE: adding temporary allowlist for top enterprise ids (cust-123,cust-456) via infra CLI to prevent immediate 429s while we stabilize.

Alice N.: enabling gateway circuit-breaker to short-circuit retry storms (reject after 3 attempts -> 503) and lowering default client retry window to 2s.

Maria Support: updating affected customer tickets. Cust-123 reporting partial recovery after our changes.

Alice N.: revert confirmation:
```
[2026-03-13T18:26:42Z] ratelimit loaded version=v1
[2026-03-13T18:27:02Z] gateway req=xyz9 status=200
```

Alice N.: metrics: cluster-wide 429s down ~78% in 6m. Backend 5xx rate dropping from 5.8% -> 1.1% and trending down. Gateway CPU normalizing.

SRE-Lead: good. Keep allowlist until customers confirm. Also add alert for retry-amplification so we don't replace one problem with another.

Brian SRE: allowlist added. Reduced retry window applied. Also scaled gateway replicas + bumped backend concurrency by 20% to absorb transient retry bursts.

Jamie (Product): draft external status: "We've applied mitigations for intermittent timeouts in us-west affecting a subset of customers; fixes rolling out, will update in 30–60 minutes." Maria to coordinate sending.

Alice N.: handing over to Brian. Handoff note: root cause = ratelimit-config:v2 misapplied cluster-level quota -> 429 flood -> client SDK retries amplified traffic -> backend 5xx/timeouts. Mitigations done: config revert, enterprise allowlist, retry limits, circuit breaker, and scaled capacity. Continue monitoring 2h.

Brian SRE: taking lead. I'll monitor dashboards and escalate if error rate or customer reports spike. Next actions: validate post-revert traffic patterns, verify no other config drift, capture config diffs.

ops-bot: deploy job completed: gateway pods stable.

Maria Support: Cust-456 confirms improved behavior; Cust-789 still seeing occasional latency, investigating.

SRE-Lead: incident state -> mitigated. Please open a postmortem ticket with timestamps, config diffs, and rollout audit. Assign Alice for root cause and Brian for mitigation write-up.

Jamie (Product): plan for a public note in ~45m if stable. Good rapid response team.

Alice N.: I'll produce the RCA after my meeting. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: paging closed. Channel will remain open for handoff window.
